items.exampleEn: A bouquet of fresh flowers sat on the hotel's front desk.
items.exampleZh: 飯店的櫃檯上擺著一束鮮花。

items.exampleEn: A bearded old man was selling fruit at the market.
items.exampleZh: 一位留著鬍子的老先生在市場賣水果。

items.exampleEn: Swimmers often have broad shoulders and a strong physique.
items.exampleZh: 游泳選手常常肩膀寬闊、體格強壯。

items.exampleEn: Some customers book a manicure during their lunch break.
items.exampleZh: 有些客人會利用午休時間預約修指甲。

items.exampleEn: Two strapping young men carried the piano upstairs.
items.exampleZh: 兩個高大結實的年輕人把鋼琴搬上樓。

items.exampleEn: After the long hike, a pedicure felt wonderful.
items.exampleZh: 長途健行之後，去修個腳趾甲感覺好舒服。

items.exampleEn: Small children look cute in tiny overalls.
items.exampleZh: 小孩子穿著迷你吊帶褲看起來很可愛。

items.sentenceEn: The bride carried a small bouquet of white roses.
items.sentenceZh: 新娘拿著一小束白玫瑰。

items.audioEn: The bearded man at the door says he is here to fix the heater.
items.audioZh: 門口那位留鬍子的男人說他是來修暖氣機的。
items.questionZh: 門口那位男人是來做什麼的？

items.sentenceEn: The actor changed his physique for his new film role.
items.sentenceZh: 那位演員為了新電影的角色改變了體格。

items.sentenceEn: The painter wore old overalls covered in paint.
items.sentenceZh: 油漆工穿著沾滿油漆的舊工作服。

items.stemEn: Their son has grown into a ____ young man, over six feet tall.
items.stemZh: 他們的兒子已經長成一個身高超過六呎、高大結實的年輕人。

items.stemEn: I treated myself to a ____ and had my fingernails painted red.
items.stemZh: 我犒賞自己去修了指甲，還把手指甲塗成紅色。

items.passageEn: The day before her wedding, Lisa spent the afternoon at a beauty salon with her sisters. They all had a manicure, and Lisa also had a pedicure because she planned to wear open-toed shoes. Meanwhile, her future husband, a strapping farmer with a thick beard, was still working in his overalls. He said he would shave the next morning, but in the end, he arrived at the ceremony still bearded, and everyone agreed it suited him. Lisa's grandmother made the bouquet from flowers in her own garden, so it had great sentimental value.
items.passageZh: 婚禮前一天，Lisa 和姊妹們在美容院待了一個下午。她們都修了指甲，Lisa 因為打算穿露趾的鞋，還另外修了腳趾甲。同一時間，她的未婚夫——一位留著濃密鬍子、高大結實的農夫——還穿著吊帶工作服在工作。他說隔天早上會刮鬍子，結果最後還是留著鬍子出現在婚禮上，大家都說很適合他。Lisa 的奶奶用自家花園的花做了捧花，所以這束花很有紀念價值。

questions.questionZh: Lisa 為什麼也去修了腳趾甲？
options: 婚禮在海邊的沙灘舉行

questions.questionZh: 新郎最後以什麼樣子出現在婚禮上？

items.promptZh: 那位老師個子很高，還留著鬍子。
referenceEn: The teacher is tall and bearded.
He is a tall, bearded teacher.
rubricZh: bearded 表示「留鬍子的」，位置有彈性（例如 is tall and bearded、a tall, bearded teacher 等）
「個子很高」可寫，例如 tall、very tall 等

items.promptZh: 畢業典禮那天，同學們送給老師一大束向日葵。
referenceEn: On graduation day, the students gave their teacher a big bouquet of sunflowers.
The students gave the teacher a large bouquet of sunflowers at the graduation ceremony.
rubricZh: 「一大束」用 bouquet（例如 a big bouquet of sunflowers 等）
「畢業典禮那天」可寫，例如 on graduation day、at the graduation ceremony 等
時態配合內容（例如 gave 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確
